summary.text: Frank Burns is a Democratic state representative from Cambria County who has represented Pennsylvania House District 72 since December 2008 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He chairs the House Professional Licensure Committee.

paragraphs.text: Burns grew up in East Taylor Township, is a lifelong resident of the region, and earned a degree in business management from the University of Pittsburgh at Johnstown, according to his official biography.
Before his legislative service he was a consultant for the cosmetic dental company Den-Mat.
He served as an East Taylor Township supervisor and spent more than six years as an elected member of the Pennsylvania Democratic State Committee.
Burns lists job growth, health-care coverage for seniors and coal and other fuel initiatives among his legislative priorities.
He chairs the Professional Licensure Committee and co-chairs the Coal Caucus.
Ballotpedia lists Republican Philip Rice as his opponent in the general election.
